company.name: TeamOut
company.shortDescription: TeamOut is the platform that makes retreat planning easy for remote teams.
company.description:
TeamOut provides an online platform to assist remote teams in finding the ideal offsite location. It handles everything from venue selection to transportation and activities.

The company was founded in 2021 and is based in San Francisco, California.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that helps companies discover and book venues for corporate retreats and offsite events, offering a large catalog of vetted properties and negotiated rates.
productsAndServices.name: Venue Sourcing Platform

productsAndServices.description: A service offering end-to-end planning support for corporate retreats, including itinerary design, vendor coordination, and attendee management.
productsAndServices.name: Retreat Planning Service

productsAndServices.description: Pre-designed retreat packages that bundle venue, activities, catering, and transportation for streamlined corporate event planning.
productsAndServices.name: Corporate Retreat Packages

productsAndServices.description: A service providing access to a variety of event spaces suitable for corporate parties, meetings, and receptions.
productsAndServices.name: Event Space Rental Service

productsAndServices.description: A service that sources and arranges team-building activities, workshops, and outdoor adventures near event venues.
productsAndServices.name: Activity Coordination Service

productsAndServices.description: A service managing group transportation logistics including shuttles, limousines, and boats for corporate events.
productsAndServices.name: Transportation Coordination Service

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,746,961 to $25,469,322, a 3.29x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 61 (-4 over 90 days) and market heat at 68 (-7).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set

insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
